title: Membership inference using inferred genomic attributes

dimensions.source: Gursoy et al., Bioinformatics 2020, Inference attacks against differentially private query results from genomic datasets including dependent tuples
dimensions.limitations: The reported attack power of 0.80 was achieved in the study's experimental membership-inference setting using inferred SNP values after approximately 170 queries, with the specified privacy parameters. It is scenario-specific and is not a universal probability that genomic-dataset membership can be inferred.
